_comment: Example candidate list. Copy to candidates.json and edit it there;
README and bench_coding both refer to candidates.json by that name.
Read by bench_sweep.py --candidates and by every tool's --compare flag.
An element carrying ONLY a _comment key is documentation and is skipped;
each other element is one measured endpoint:
backend   name from backends.json (supplies base_url, model, api key)
base_url  explicit endpoint, overrides the backend's URL
model     model id; falls back to the backend's default
label     what the ranking, the report and bench_compare key on
LABEL THE LANES. The two GenieX entries below serve the SAME GGUF: with
no label both would resolve to the bare model id, the ranking would show
one row and bench_compare would read a 3/3 -> 0/3 collapse as unchanged.
Colliding derived labels are disambiguated with the backend name;
colliding EXPLICIT labels are refused, because only you know which is which.
